action.sql: select pr.supplier_id, pi.store_id, case when pi.date<'2025-04-01' then 'pred' else 'po' end obdobi, round(avg(pi.unit_price/pr.base_price),3) pomer_ceny, round(avg(pi.unit_price),1) cena, sum(pi.quantity) q, count(*) n from purchase_item pi join product pr on pr.id=pi.product_id where pi.line_kind='základní položka' group by 1,2,3 order by 1,2,3
